title: The same near-miss still catches a top-level type mismatch
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: This is why the bug ships unnoticed: it is not silent about everything, only about what is nested. A field of the wrong container type at the top level is still caught; it is only the contents of a correctly-typed Object or Array that never get looked at.
